text: Bronze, Silver, and Gold are built, and the Eventhouse already reads the same Kafka topic independently. Neither has a human-facing screen yet. We're building two, on purpose, for two different audiences.

A Fabric report on package_status_gold and delivery_performance_gold for Operations' trends, refreshing every 15 minutes -- and a confirmed, verified check that the Eventhouse's live lookup for Support is actually working, not just connected. These stay two separate surfaces, not one dashboard.
Every DAX measure is a direct read of a column Gold already resolved -- validated by hand against a query on Gold before a single visual gets built.

The real test for the live feed isn't the Fabric portal's connected indicator -- it's calling LatestPackageStatus() for a package in transit, waiting a few minutes, and confirming the timestamp actually moved.
Both surfaces are verified and working. Next: the real meeting where Operations and Support see them together -- and where we talk honestly about the bug Support actually lived through.
